simple.meaning: מִצְעָד (mitsʻâd) is a Hebrew word meaning “a step ; figuratively, companionship.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: מִצְעָד (H4703) appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Psalms 37:23, with occurrences in Psalms, Proverbs, Daniel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מִצְעָד (H4703) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in מִצְעָד (H4703) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: מִצְעָד (mitsʻâd) / H4703 is traced through Psalms 37:23, Proverbs 20:24, Daniel 11:43 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

firstOccurrence.englishText: A man’s steps are established by Yahweh.

timeline.evidenceText: A man’s steps are established by Yahweh.
A man’s steps are from Yahweh;
But he will have power over the treasures of gold and of silver, and over all the precious things of Egypt. The Libyans and the Ethiopians will be at his steps.
